alt_title: Campa Doubled Its Share. Coke and Pepsi Fell to 85%
description: Coca-Cola and PepsiCo held 93% of India's soft drinks market in January to September 2024. In the same months of 2025 they held 85%, while Campa and Lahori Zeera together went from about 7% to almost 15% (NielsenIQ data cited by industry sources, reported 25 Nov 2025).

Reliance bought the Campa brand in August 2022 and brought it back in March 2023 at ₹10 for 200 ml. Coke and Pepsi answered with their own ₹10 packs, down from ₹12 and above. Shares are of all soft drinks, not cola alone.
question: Which is in your fridge: Campa, Coke, Pepsi or Thums Up?
x: India's soft drinks, Jan-Sep 2025 vs 2024: Coke and Pepsi 93% to 85%. Campa and Lahori Zeera together about 7% to almost 15%. The fight is at ₹10. Source: NielsenIQ via industry sources (Storyboard18, 25 Nov 2025).
instagram: The cola war is now fought at ₹10. Campa and Lahori Zeera doubled their share of India's soft drinks to almost 15% (Jan-Sep 2025); Coke and Pepsi fell from 93% to 85%. Which is in your fridge?
